question: How many days of leave do I have?
expected_answer: Depends: 24 days for full-time, pro rata for part-time (e.g. 12 days for 20 h/week), plus 1 extra day per 5 years of service up to 27; special leave is separate.
answer:

- **Full-time employees** receive **24 working days** of paid annual leave per calendar year.
- **Part-time employees** receive leave in proportion to their contracted hours (for example, 20 hours per week receives 12 days).
- After **5 years** of continuous service, employees receive **1 extra day** for every additional 5 years of service, up to a maximum of **27 days** per year.
- Employees who join during the year receive a pro-rata entitlement from their start date (rounded up to the nearest half day). 
- During the **probation period** (first 90 days), you may take **up to 5 days** of annual leave with the approval of your line manager (as noted in the **Onboarding Guide for New Employees**).
